preconditions: Valid KYC/KYB verified entity (User or Merchant) exists
Entity must not have an active AML hold status
Ledger engine must have a balanced initial root state (zero-sum validation)
data_invariants: Sum of all debits must exactly equal sum of all credits in every transaction (double-entry constraint)
Ledger entries must be immutable (append-only table schema)
Currency codes must be ISO 4217 compliant
Amounts must be stored as integers representing the lowest currency denominator (e.g., cents)
postconditions: Two distinct ledger entry rows created: 1 Debit, 1 Credit
Wallet available balance synchronously updated via materialized view or trigger
Transaction reference UUID generated and returned to client
error_states: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Debit amount exceeds available balance
LEDGER_IMBALANCE_DETECTED: Transaction debit/credit arrays do not sum to 0
WALLET_FROZEN: Target wallet is locked for compliance reasons

preconditions: Applicant email must be verified via OTP
Applicant must provide a valid Employer Identification Number (EIN) or SSN
data_invariants: EIN must match the 9-digit US format XX-XXXXXXX
Beneficial Ownership information must sum to exactly 100% equity distribution
Application status must transition linearly: DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> IN_REVIEW -> APPROVED/REJECTED
postconditions: KYB payload dispatched to external underwriting API (e.g., Stripe Connect / Alloy)
Merchant entity record created in `merchant_profiles` table
Default clearing bank account securely tokenized
error_states: KYB_VERIFICATION_FAILED: Automated identity check returned false
DUPLICATE_EIN: The provided tax ID is already registered in the system
INVALID_EQUITY_DISTRIBUTION: Ownership shares do not equal 100%

preconditions: POS Terminal must be authenticated and assigned to a valid Location ID
Shift must be strictly OPEN for the interacting server
Target table ID must exist in the active floor plan
data_invariants: Order state must follow: OPEN -> FIRED -> BILLED -> PAID -> CLOSED
Tax calculated must equal the sum of (Item Price * Line Item Tax Rate)
Table status must be mutually exclusive (e.g., cannot be 'AVAILABLE' if order is 'OPEN')
postconditions: Order lines committed to `pos_orders` and `pos_order_items` tables
KDS (Kitchen Display System) routing events triggered via WebSockets
Table status updated to 'OCCUPIED' or 'BILLED'
error_states: SHIFT_CLOSED: Attempted to open order outside of active shift
TABLE_CONFLICT: Attempted to seat guests at an already occupied table
MENU_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: Item requested is marked 86'd (out of stock)

preconditions: Employer must have valid state tax registration IDs
Employees must have active W-4 configuration on file
Timesheet data for the pay period must be explicitly approved by management
data_invariants: Gross Pay = (Regular Hours * Rate) + (Overtime Hours * OT Rate) + Tips
Net Pay = Gross Pay - PreTax Deductions - Taxes - PostTax Deductions
Net Pay must be >= 0
Overtime must strictly apply for hours > 40 per workweek (Federal FLSA)
postconditions: Payroll Run object transitioned to 'LOCKED' state
ACH NACHA file generated for direct deposits
Tax liability staging records created for automated remittance
error_states: NEGATIVE_NET_PAY: Deductions exceed gross earnings
MISSING_TIMESHEET_APPROVAL: Hours submitted but not manager approved
INVALID_TAX_JURISDICTION: Employee address unmapped to a tax engine locale

preconditions: Valid Payment Method Token (Network Token or PCI-compliant vault token)
Order amount > 0
Merchant processing account must be ACTIVE
data_invariants: Authorization amount must exactly equal requested checkout amount
Capture amount must be <= Authorization amount
Tokenization format must comply with PCI-DSS standards (no raw PAN storage)
postconditions: Processor gateway returns valid Authorization Code and Network Transaction ID
Ledger updated with a 'Pending Hold' entry for the auth amount
Order status advanced to 'PAID' or 'PARTIALLY_PAID'
error_states: DECLINED_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Issuer rejected due to balance
DECLINED_FRAUD_RISK: High-risk indicators triggered gateway rejection
EXPIRED_AUTHORIZATION: Capture attempted after auth window (typically 7 days) elapsed

preconditions: Valid credentials (email/password hash match) or valid MFA token provided
User account status must be ACTIVE (not suspended or deleted)
data_invariants: JWT must be signed using RS256 algorithm
Access tokens must have a strict expiration <= 15 minutes
Refresh tokens must be stored in HTTP-only, secure cookies or secure enclaves
Passwords must be hashed using Argon2id or bcrypt
postconditions: Short-lived Access Token and long-lived Refresh Token issued
Successful login event logged in the Security Audit Trail with IP and User-Agent
Failed attempts counter reset to 0
error_states: INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Hash mismatch
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Exceeded maximum retry threshold (brute force protection)
MFA_REQUIRED: Primary auth succeeded but secondary factor pending

preconditions: User must possess a valid RBAC role definition
Target resource must belong to a node within the user's hierarchy graph
data_invariants: Hierarchy levels are strictly: ROOT -> BRAND -> FRANCHISEE -> LOCATION
A Location must have exactly one parent Franchisee
Permissions flow downwards: Brand admins inherit access to Franchisees and Locations, but not vice-versa
postconditions: Data access scoped strictly to the authorized hierarchy depth (e.g., query adds `location_id IN (descendants)`)
Context-aware JWT minted containing `context_node_id` and `context_level`
error_states: HIERARCHY_VIOLATION_403: Attempt to access a node outside permitted branch
ORPHANED_NODE: Attempted to create a Location without a valid parent Franchisee
ROLE_INSUFFICIENT: Action requires a permission not granted by the current hierarchy role

preconditions: Tenant has an active subscription tier configured
Tenant has a default payment method attached to their billing profile
Current date is >= Next Billing Date
data_invariants: Subscription status transitions: ACTIVE -> PAST_DUE -> UNPAID -> CANCELED
Dunning cycle spans exactly 14 days with 3 distinct retry attempts
Invoice line items must strictly map to provisioned usage or base tier fees
postconditions: Invoice generated in `invoices` table and marked 'PAID'
Next Billing Date incremented by exactly 1 billing period (e.g., +1 month)
Payment receipt emailed to tenant billing contacts
error_states: PAYMENT_FAILED: Default card declined, transition to PAST_DUE
NO_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD: Billing profile lacks a chargeable instrument
SUBSCRIPTION_SUSPENDED: Max dunning retries exhausted, service locked

preconditions: Location ID must be actively accepting online orders
Shopping cart must contain at least 1 valid, available menu item
Requested fulfillment time must fall within location's operational hours
data_invariants: Cart total must equal sum of items + modifiers + delivery fee + taxes + tip
Delivery polygons/radiuses strictly enforced for delivery fulfillment type
Inventory levels for 86'd items must be strictly validated immediately prior to checkout lock
postconditions: Order object created with source 'ONLINE'
Payment Authorized
Order immediately pushed to Location's KDS via WebSocket queue
error_states: LOCATION_CLOSED: Store is not accepting orders at this time
OUT_OF_DELIVERY_ZONE: Customer address unmapped to delivery boundaries
ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: A cart item became out of stock during checkout

preconditions: Destination address (or Location address for pickup) is fully resolved
Cart contains categorized line items (e.g., Grocery vs. Prepared Food)
data_invariants: Tax calculation must apply item-level taxability rules (e.g., cold food untaxed in some states, hot food taxed)
Total tax must be the exact sum of all applicable jurisdiction taxes (State + County + City + Special)
Rounding must follow standard half-up logic to 2 decimal places per line item
postconditions: Tax quote object attached to the draft order payload
Detailed tax breakdown provided for the customer receipt (tax lines)
Tax nexus liability staged for month-end reporting
error_states: GEOCODING_FAILURE: Address could not be resolved to a specific tax jurisdiction
TAX_ENGINE_TIMEOUT: External tax provider (e.g., Avalara/TaxJar) failed to respond within 500ms
UNCATEGORIZED_ITEM: Menu item lacks necessary tax code metadata
